key_findings: Historical simulation requires separate market-evidence and processing cutoffs. Later processing is safe only when its complete inputs are bound to the frozen market evidence set.
W33-W34 demonstrate that unavailable historical learning state must remain unavailable rather than be reconstructed from later registries.
W35 demonstrates material value from duplicate-adjusted experiment-family context: many raw directional candidates do not equal independent confirmation.
W36 demonstrates material value from Range Lab context: supportive ETH range evidence improved interpretation of an unresolved transition without creating a forecast-skill claim.

W37 exposes a concrete integration gap: the weekly package marked experiment registry evidence unavailable even though fresh pre-cutoff experiment learning existed. A consultation/learning pointer would have improved the consolidation rationale without canonical promotion.
Exact input manifests are required for any post-freeze adjudication or learning job intended for same-Monday Master Monday consumption.
The value of the architecture is primarily calibration, contradiction handling, memory and information utilization rather than adding more raw signals.
required_before_phase1: Keep all Phase 0 artifacts isolated from live consumers.
Phase 1 must run parallel shadow only and must not change the live Master Monday conclusion or Cycle Navigator output.
Implement provenance-bound learning/adjudication input manifests before allowing same-Monday post-freeze processing to become eligible consultation context.
Use duplicate-adjusted semantic families rather than raw candidate counts.
Keep RANGE learning explicitly research-only until relevant scientific promotion gates are satisfied.
Record consultation requests, accepted/rejected specialist advice and evidence exclusions for later process-value analysis.
